findings.description: The requirement is framed entirely as a call-ordering change ('캡처 호출 지점이 fencing 게이트보다 앞서야 한다'; title 'must be ordered before authority fencing'; Implementation Notes '캡처 호출을 게이트 이전으로 옮기는 국소 순서 변경이다'). That is true for writeInput but false for resize: SessionManager.resize (3401-3446) contains no captureDebugEvent call at all, and captureDebugEvent exists in no other server file. Its only observability is this.wsRouter?.recordReplayEvent({kind:'resize_requested'}) at ~3414, a replay event, not a debug-capture event gated by isDebugCaptureEnabled. Consequences: (a) the Rationale claim '현재 서버 구현은 fencing 실패 시 캡처 이전에 return 하므로' is inaccurate for resize — nothing returns before a capture because there is no capture; (b) AC-2 in fact requires creating a new resize capture path, not reordering one; (c) AC-4 ('캡처 이벤트의 페이로드 필드 집합을 기존 캡처 경로 대비 확대해서는 안 된다') has no baseline for resize and is therefore undecidable for half of the requirement's scope.

findings.description: AC-7's stated purpose is to prevent the CI E2E gate from immediately blocking the release pipeline ('그렇지 않으면 게이트 도입 즉시 릴리스 파이프라인이 막힌다'). Satisfying AC-7 does not achieve that: seven further E2E tests are structurally unpassable for the same root cause. pane-split.spec.ts TC-6101/TC-6103/TC-6105/TC-6107/TC-6104 all call rightClickPane, which locates '.pane-leaf' (helpers.ts:476), and pane-persistence.spec.ts TC-6401/TC-6403 call rightClickPane or verifyPaneCount. '.pane-leaf', '.pane-resizer' and '.pane-zoom-badge' are absent from frontend/src. So a push/pull_request E2E gate would still block release after OPS-BGSTAB-003 is fully closed. OPS-BGSTAB-003 Implementation Notes explicitly excludes those two specs, and OPS-BGSTAB-005 Implementation Notes defers them to '그 spec 을 다루는 요구' — but no such requirement exists in wave-3 or elsewhere in the SRS. The narrowing of AC-7 (correct for decidability) left a dangling dependency on a nonexistent requirement.

Both REQs (Rationale and Trace Links) cite 'SessionManager.ts:2976' as the shadow short-circuit and 'acceptRetainedTerminalMutationIdentity (2975-3011)'. Actual: the method is declared at 2972, its signature closes at 2975, line 2976 is 'const retained = this.ensureRetainedTerminalSessionState(data);', and the short-circuit 'if (retained.mode !== \'shadow\') return true;' is at 2977. The phrase 'whose first statement short-circuits' is also wrong — it is the second statement. The substantive claim is correct; only the pointers are off by one and the range excludes the declaration.

Trace row cites 'frontend/src/contexts/WebSocketContext.tsx ... StrictMode double-mount stale WebSocket guard already implemented (1233-1237)'. Lines 1233-1237 are the ws.onmessage opening plus four comment lines; the guard statement 'if (wsRef.current !== ws) return;' is at 1238, one line past the cited range.

Trace row says 'no test execution step anywhere in the 351-line workflow'. release.yml is 350 lines. The substantive claim is correct — all seven case-insensitive 'test' hits are 'ubuntu-latest', 'windows-latest', '.test(content)' regex calls and 'Test-Path'; release.yml is indeed the only file in .github/workflows.
Trace row cites 'frontend/src/components/Workspace/DisconnectedOverlay.tsx ... (1-37)'. The file is 36 lines.

Trace row says hasDeploymentArtifacts 'decides reuse from fs.existsSync alone'. It also calls hasCompleteWebArtifacts (tools/start-runtime.js:252-272), which readFileSync-parses index.html and existence-checks every local asset reference. The substantive claim ('no freshness comparison') is correct; 'fs.existsSync alone' understates the helper. Cited range (242-250) is exact.

pane_leaf_observation.detail: grep -rn 'pane-leaf' frontend/src returns zero hits. The selector occurs only in frontend/tests/e2e/helpers.ts, frontend/tests/e2e/pane-split.spec.ts and frontend/tests/e2e/pane-persistence.spec.ts. '.pane-resizer' and '.pane-zoom-badge' are likewise absent from frontend/src (only '.context-menu-item' and '.context-menu' exist in production source).

affected_specs.reason: Every test starts with rightClickPane(page, 0), which does page.locator('.pane-leaf').nth(index).click({button:'right'}) and then waits for '.context-menu' (helpers.ts:476-479). With zero '.pane-leaf' elements the click times out, so all five tests — including TC-6104, which otherwise only inspects '.context-menu-item' — fail before their own assertions. TC-6101/TC-6103 additionally assert verifyPaneCount; TC-6105 dereferences boundingBox() of '.pane-leaf' and drags '.pane-resizer' (absent); TC-6107 asserts '.pane-zoom-badge' (absent).
TC-6401 calls rightClickPane then verifyPaneCount(page, 2); TC-6403 calls verifyPaneCount(page, 1). Both assert a nonzero '.pane-leaf' count against markup that does not exist in frontend/src.
